description: Look up a product by Lowvyn ID OR retailer URL (amazon.ca, walmart.ca, bestbuy.ca, canadiantire.ca, canadacomputers.com, newegg.ca, visions.ca). Returns title, current price (CAD), Lowvyn Score (0-100), Deal Verdict, and price summary (current / all-time low / all-time high). watchUrl is a lowvyn.com link where the user can get an email when the price drops. checkUrl and extensionUrl are returned when the product is not tracked yet.
